title: Seagrove "Shore Beats Work" 151 Dalton Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private heated pool and sitting spa **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- Walkable distance to The Greenway Station - Shopping & Dining- 6 passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Professionally decorated - 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. DETAILS: It will be hard to say goodbye to Shore Beats Work. This brand new 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom Seagrove Beach home sleeps 16 in sumptuous comfort. Guests will enjoy a short walk to the beach, a private heated pool with a wide sun shelf and sitting spa, 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle, multiple porches, and spaces designed for long conversations. Guests enter Shore Beats Work from a comfy front porch with views of the surrounding woods. A spacious living and dining area have pale wood floors, white shiplap walls, and lots of natural light from glass doors that open to an outdoor courtyard. Rattan chairs, a wet bar with wine chiller, bookshelves with a natural wood finish, and 2 sofas and armchairs surround a gas fireplace with a flat-screen TV. Around the corner, a kitchen outfitted in whites and grays has a marble waterfall island that seats 4, a gas range, and premium appliances. French doors from the kitchen open to the courtyard’s covered porch, where cushioned chairs swivel to face a mounted flat-screen TV or the spacious pool. Guests will enjoy the wide sun shelf and sitting spa that spills into the shimmering blue pool. A guest bedroom off the kitchen has a king bed, a private bathroom with a shower, and sliding glass doors opening to the pool and courtyard. A primary bedroom on the second floor has an arched ceiling, king bed, and a sitting area with chairs and a flat-screen TV, tucked into an alcove leading to French doors that open to a balcony overlooking the pool. The room’s dramatic private bathroom has a soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, and double vanity. A guest bedroom with a queen bed also has French doors that open to the balcony overlooking the pool and shares a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a bunk room that has 2 full-over-full bunk beds. A third guest bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests of Shore Beats Work will also enjoy 5-included adult bikes, making it easy to explore the beloved community of Seagrove Beach. With this location and these amenities, Shore Beats Work won’t last long. Book this dream home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only SECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Jack-N-Jill Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Two Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Jack-N-Jill Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home.
